title: Text to Speech
description: Text to Speech is a translation ability in the Cross-Media Translation Pipelines database. Turns written text into natural spoken audio. The pipeline handles pronunciation, pauses, and emphasis from punctuation. It takes text and produces audio. Tunable parameters: per voice. Guarantee: pronunciations are always reviewable.

fields.mechanism: The pipeline handles pronunciation, pauses, and emphasis from punctuation.

title: Speech to Text
description: Speech to Text is a translation ability in the Cross-Media Translation Pipelines database. Transcribes spoken audio into accurate text. Recognition runs with speaker labels and timestamps; confidence marks each word. It takes audio and produces transcript. Tunable parameters: per speaker. Guarantee: low-confidence words are always flagged.

fields.mechanism: Recognition runs with speaker labels and timestamps; confidence marks each word.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Image Description
description: Image Description is a translation ability in the Cross-Media Translation Pipelines database. Describes images in words for those who cannot see them. Descriptions cover subjects, actions, setting, and mood in two lengths. It takes image and produces alt text. Tunable parameters: short + long. Guarantee: descriptions never invent unseen details.

fields.mechanism: Descriptions cover subjects, actions, setting, and mood in two lengths.

title: Video Captioning
description: Video Captioning is a translation ability in the Cross-Media Translation Pipelines database. Captions video with timed, readable subtitles. Speech is transcribed and timed to frames; captions break at phrase boundaries. It takes video and produces captions. Tunable parameters: per frame. Guarantee: captions never lag speech by over 0.5 s.

fields.mechanism: Speech is transcribed and timed to frames; captions break at phrase boundaries.
fields.guarantees: captions never lag speech by over 0.5 s

Text maps to sign sequences; the avatar performs them in sync with the audio. It takes speech and produces signing video. Tunable parameters: per language. Guarantee: avatars always show the full message.

title: Braille Conversion

Guarantee: pipelines never lose the source media.
